# Footnotes {#footnotes}

A footnote body owns only its indented continuation, so an unindented line after it starts a new block (C2-B-081, C2-B-087). A footnote mark inside link text is written after the link anchor (C2-H-088).

**U-042** <Badge type="info" text="none" /> Definitions that read the same

::: compare no-render
```text
Text[^n].

[^n]: first
[^n]: second
```
```html
<p>Text<a id="fnref1" href="#fn1" role="doc-noteref"><sup>1</sup></a>.</p>
<section role="doc-endnotes" aria-label="Footnotes">
  <hr>
  <ol>
    <li id="fn1">
      <p>first<a href="#fnref1" role="doc-backlink" aria-label="Back to reference">↩</a></p>
    </li>
  </ol>
</section>
```
:::

**U-154** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-H-088, a footnote reference in link text, `[see this[^1] page](/u)` with the definition `[^1]: n`, wrote its mark inside the anchor in 0.1: &lt;a href="/u"&gt;see this&lt;sup id="fnref1"&gt;1&lt;/sup&gt; page&lt;/a&gt;.
Tool: Review.

::: compare no-render
```text
[see this[^1] page](/u)

[^1]: n
```
```text
<p><a href="/u">see this page</a><a id="fnref1" href="#fn1" role="doc-noteref"><sup>1</sup></a></p> C2-H-088: a note mark in link text is written after the closing anchor of the outermost link; 0.1 wrote it inside the anchor.
```
:::

```text
g]
```


**U-207** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-I-088 and C2-H-139, an unresolved footnote reference with glued attribute blocks, `Text[^a]{.c}{#i}.`, writes the blocks as typed in 0.1.
Tool: Review.

::: compare no-render
```text
Text[^a]{.c}{#i}.
```
```text
<p>Text[^a]{#i .c}.</p> An unresolved footnote reference writes its glued attribute blocks as one block in the fixed order (C2-I-088, C2-I-085, C2-H-139); 0.1 wrote them as typed, `Text[^a]{.c}{#i}.`. No rewrite is recorded; review.
```
:::

A definition indented into a footnote body, `[^a]: first` then `  [^b]: second`, also defines `b` in 0.1.

```text
- [^a]: note body
```

**U-388** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> A footnote-shaped run inside an insertion inside an inline note: `^[{+[^[g]+}] b+}]`. 0.1 keeps `[^[g]+}] b` in the insertion; 0.2 closes the insertion at the first `+}`.
Tool: Report from the inline footnote opener through its closing bracket.

::: compare no-render
```text
^[{+[^[g]+}] b+}]
```
```text
<p><a id="fnref1" href="#fn1" role="doc-noteref"><sup>1</sup></a></p>
<section role="doc-endnotes" aria-label="Footnotes">
  <hr>
  <ol>
    <li id="fn1">
      <p><ins>[^[g]</ins>] b+}<a href="#fnref1" role="doc-backlink" aria-label="Back to reference">↩</a></p>
    </li>
  </ol>
</section> Nested brackets inside an inline footnote pair differently under C2-I-089, splitting the insertion at a different closer. Report the source range from the inline footnote opener through its closing bracket.
```
:::
